messages:
sophie: Quick sync — thinking of rolling a minor bump (v1.14.0 -> v1.15.0) to include the tokenizer edge-case fix. Cutoff is EOD today. Can we extend cutoff to 3pm PT tomorrow to finish canary verification? @raj @marta
raj: what's blocking for you? tests flaked or infra hiccup?
marta: a mix — a quantization profile regression on rtx nodes plus a flaky eval. I have a local reproducer but need the full eval run to be confident. canary hasn't reached prod pool yet.
kevin: if we extend the cutoff we should hold the public announcement. marketing will need a new ETA.
sophie: agreed — hold the public announce. We keep internal canary only until we sign off, then I'll post to #announcements.
marta: repro steps for the regression:
```
git checkout release/v1.14
git pull
make test-evals MODEL=redwood-7b SEQ=1024
```
marta: and note — Dedicated customers will need a backport to hotfix/1.14 if we ship this.
raj: ok I'll prepare a backport branch and PR. tagging @lee for review once draft is up. PR headline will include "hotfix: tokenizer edge-case backport"
lee: can review in ~30m. if it's small i'll approve and merge.
deploy-bot: Canary deployment started for v1.15.0-canary on pool-us-west-2. Build id: bld-4821
sophie: action items: marta run full evals, raj open backport PR, lee review, i'll delay public announce and update #announcements after canary passes. update in ~2h or sooner if canary finishes.
kevin: copying. @product-ops please hold the announcement draft until we say go.
marta: quick canary tweak — cache warm-up spikes memory on first run, add `--cache-size=2G` to canary job to avoid OOMs for the eval window.
raj: noted, adding `--cache-size=2G` to the canary job and backport PR.
sophie: ping me if anything blocks. thanks :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Canary finished — 5/5 checks passed, p50/p95 latencies within SLOs, error rate 0.1%. Holding for 1h observation before promote.
lee: approving backport now.
raj: merged backport + cherry-pick to hotfix/1.14, created tag v1.14.1-rc1
sophie: perfect. i'll update #announcements with a short ETA shift message: "Public announce delayed; tentative tomorrow 3pm PT" once the observation window is green.
kevin: sounds good. quick heads-up to sales to avoid surprises.
marta: final reminder — add a clear changelog line for the tokenizer fix and note the Dedicated backport.
sophie: will add changelog entry and closing loop after the observation window. thanks everyone!
